title: Which sectors are the winners from the AI breakthrough
author: Keith Mason
text:
RESEARCH BRIEFING

11 Nov 2026

Which sectors are the winners from the AI breakthrough

Discover how AI advancements will reshape global economies, boosting knowledge
sectors while traditional industries face challenges in growth.

Knowledge-intensive service sectors are set to benefit significantly from advancements in AI technology. By 2040, global gross value added (GVA) is projected to rise by approximately 6% higher than our baseline forecast in this scenario, with sectors like information and communications technology (ICT) and financial services seeing GVA around 9% to 10% above baseline.

In contrast, the physical economy, including agriculture, extraction, and
construction, is expected to see minimal growth—less than 1% in agriculture and
only 3% in both extraction and construction. These sectors face challenges due
to their reliance on manual, on-site work, limiting AI’s impact.

The report highlights that the 2030s will be pivotal, with substantial
productivity gains anticipated as AI adoption becomes mainstream. Financial and
business services are expected to lead this growth, while sectors like
manufacturing and agriculture may lag behind, with less than half of their
projected gains realised by 2035.
